content:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick 15m: rapid onramp walkthrough for DataFlux (usage hit)

Hi Samir / Elena,

Saw DataFlux cross the 75k token/day threshold this morning — congrats on the ramp! Based on what we've seen with similar teams, a short 15-minute walkthrough usually helps unblock the first production questions and surfaces quick savings (batching + KV caching).

Proposed agenda (15m):
- 3 min: quick goals and production use case
- 7 min: runtime knobs we recommend for prompt / latency profile
- 3 min: immediate actions + follow-ups (can include a quick mutual action plan)

I have the following windows open (PDT):
- Today (Mar 11): 10:30–10:45, 14:00–14:15
- Tue (Mar 12): 09:00–09:15, 11:00–11:15

Self-schedule here if any of those work: https://calendar.redwood.com/bc/meet/ben/15m-slot?cid=DF-4781

Attached: mutual-action-plan.pdf (stub), demo-checklist.md (stub).

If you'd prefer, I can loop in Connor (solutions engineer) to go deeper on model config, and Marissa (CS) for onboarding tasks — cc'd.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Development Rep, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193
